01 · The Idea

Find what makes you, you.

A great website starts before the first page is designed.

We dig into your business to understand what makes it different. Your story, your personality, how you work, how you treat your customers and the details that set you apart.

That’s where we find the idea. The creative direction that gives your website its own voice, look and personality. It should do more than explain your business. It should feel like your business.

Find Your Spark

02 · The Flight Plan

Set the destination.
Map the course.

Before we build, we need to know where your business wants to go and who we need to reach.

We define your target customer, what matters to them and what action we want them to take. Then we look at your goals, budget and what you already have to map the most direct and effective route forward.

Now we have an idea, an audience and a destination. Let’s build something that gets you there.

Let’s Build Something That Works

03 · The Creative

Bring it all together.

The idea. Your story. Your customers. Your goals.

Now we turn everything we’ve learned into a creative direction for your website. The look, the message and the experience start working together to represent your business and connect with the people you want to reach.

This is where your business starts taking shape online.

Bring It to Life

04 · The Build

Now let’s make it real.

This is where the plan takes shape.

We design the look, organize the content and build each page around how your customers will actually use it. Every section has a job, from making the right first impression to guiding people toward a call, visit, booking or purchase.

Need more than web design? We can create the pieces too. Photography, video, graphics, branding and content.

Start the Build

05 · Go / Flight Check

Make sure everything
works together.

A website has a lot of moving parts. Before launch, we make sure they all work together.

We test the UX and UI, forms, links, mobile experience and functionality. We make sure your email, analytics, Meta Pixel, tracking, integrations and other tools are built in and doing what they’re supposed to do.

From what your customers see to everything happening behind the scenes, we check the complete system and make sure your website is ready for business.

Clear for Launch

The foundation is built. The doors are open. Now it’s time to tell people you’re here.

Website Design Q&A

A Few Things You Might Be Wondering.

I already have Facebook and Instagram. Do I really need a website?

Yes. Social media is great for updates, conversations and staying in front of your audience, but it only shows a small piece of your business at a time.

Your website is your 24/7 showroom. It gives you the stage to tell your story, present your services, show your work and guide customers toward the next step, all in one place.

Social media keeps people connected. Your website shows them who you are and why they should choose you.

How much does a website cost?

A website can range from around $2,000 to $50,000+, depending on what you need.

A basic website might include a home page, gallery and contact page. Larger projects may include dozens or thousands of products, e-commerce, booking systems, memberships, custom features, integrations, photography, video, content and more.

Tell us what you need and we’ll help you determine the right scope and budget for your business.

How long does it take to build a website?

A landing page can usually be completed in about a week. A basic business website may take around two weeks, while larger or more custom projects can take a month or longer.

The timeline also depends on how quickly we receive your content, materials and feedback.

I don’t have a domain or hosting yet. Is that a problem?

Not at all. We can help with your domain, hosting and everything you need to get online.

If you just need a simple landing page, we can even host it with Highway 19 Media so you can get started without paying for a separate domain, hosting and full website.

I already have a website. Can you redesign it?

Absolutely. We can redesign what you have, rebuild it on a different platform or improve the parts that aren’t working.

We’ll look at your current website first and determine what’s worth keeping, what needs improvement and what makes sense for your business.

Do I need to provide all the photos and content?

No. If you already have good material, we’ll use it. If something is missing, we can create it.

Highway 19 Media can handle photography, video, graphics, branding and content, so the pieces of your website can be created together instead of coming from five different places.

Will my website work on phones and tablets?

Yes. Your website is designed with UX and UI for desktop, tablet and mobile.

We make sure the information is easy to find, the site is easy to use and customers have a clear path to call, contact, book, visit or buy.

Can you build an online store?

Yes. We can build anything from a small product store to a much larger e-commerce website.

Products, payments, shipping, inventory, customer accounts and other features can all be built around how your business actually operates.

Can you build something more custom than a normal website?

Yes. Booking systems, memberships, directories, catalogs, customer portals, CRM integrations, forms, custom tools and unusual ideas are all possible.

Tell us what you want the website to do. We’ll figure out how to build it.

What platform do you build websites on?

We work with platforms including Webflow, WordPress, Shopify and Magento.

The platform should fit the project, not the other way around. We’ll recommend the right technology based on what you need today and where the website may need to go in the future.

Can you connect my website to my marketing and business tools?

Yes. We can build in forms, email, analytics, Meta Pixel, CRM integrations and other tools your business needs.

The goal is not just to build something that looks good. It should be ready to work with your marketing and the rest of your business.

Will I own my website?

Yes. Once the project is completed and paid for, we provide the website access and credentials covered by your project agreement.

Your website is built for your business.

Do I have to keep paying Highway 19 Media after the website launches?

No. You can take the keys and run with it.

If you want us to stay involved, we can help with maintenance, updates, new content, advertising and marketing, but ongoing service is optional.

Can we meet in person?

Yes. We’re local and based in Spring Hill, serving businesses throughout the Tampa Bay area.

We can meet in person when it makes sense, visit your business, or handle the project through phone and video calls.

I’m not sure what kind of website I need. Where do I start?

Start with your business, not the website.

Tell us what you do, who your customers are, what you want the website to accomplish and what budget you’re working with. We’ll help you figure out what makes sense before you start spending money.

Still Have Questions?

Tell us what you’re trying to build. We’ll help you find the right route.
